rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but likely overstates visibility/quality of ICM and TE from this soft, somewhat collapsed/out-of-focus image; notes plausible stage discrepancy appropriately.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, first-cycle status, male-factor context, BMI/lifestyle, and missing endometrial data with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with appropriate caveats about morphology versus euploidy and uterine factors; minor issue is confidence in morphology despite limited image clarity.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice guidelines: SET for a good-quality Day-5 blastocyst in a 34-year-old, standard luteal support, no bed rest, limited workup after one failure; slight imperfection from leaning on a possibly inconsistent 3AA/expanded description without stronger correction.

Provides practical next steps for transfer management and contingency planning, including SET, endometrial review, luteal support, and selective further testing; useful though not highly tailored beyond standard IVF management.
